description: Sets columns of every row matching the filter to a constant, another column of the same row, a value looked up in another sheet, or a value chosen by the row's dates (phase: past, in progress or future, for statuses). Runs inside the work screen, so row data never passes through the AI. Returns the counts and conflicts.

dryRun.description: If true, return the counts only and change nothing (default false)

attr.description: Attribute or column name. Join child attributes with a dot, e.g. EXT_WOPERMIT.EXT_PERMITDATE

copyFrom.description: Another column of the same row

contains.description: The text on this side contains the other side's name (both after normalize and rewrite; names shorter than 2 characters are not used)

col.description: Free-text column on this (left) side, e.g. the work done

targetCol.description: Name column on the other side. With via, the column whose value is looked up in another sheet

via.description: Take the name from another sheet, e.g. {sheet:"Assets",matchCol:"ASSETNUM",sourceCol:"DESCRIPTION"} for a work order's ASSETNUM

dateWithin.description: The date on this side falls within the other side's start to end (by day, inclusive). Dates written as 2026-05-04, 2026/5/4 or in the Japanese era (R8.5.4), with or without the Japanese year, month and day marks, are read as they are; do not rewrite them

targetEnd.description: End date column on the other side, e.g. ACTFINISH. Blank: the start day only

targetStart.description: Start date column on the other side, e.g. ACTSTART

dictionaries.description: Customer dictionaries of names to apply first, to the text of this (left) side only (how the customer writes a name → the name in Maximo). Use the customer's dictionaries listed in get_status. Prefer adding entries to a dictionary over one-off rewrite rules, so the people can see and keep them

followsAbove.description: A row whose text matches pattern and that has no single match of its own takes the record of the row directly above, when that row matched one record

pattern.description: Regular expression for ditto rows (a ditto mark or word at the start of the text), tested on the text as written

group.description: Column on this side naming one document (e.g. a report number). Use it only when one document is about one record: if the rows that matched one record agree, every row of the document gets it; if they disagree, all its rows are ambiguous

matchCol.description: Match column(s) on this sheet (equal values). For a composite key use an array, e.g. ["SITEID","EXT_EQUIPTAG"]. May be omitted when contains or dateWithin is given

rewrite.description: Rules that make nicknames and variant spellings the same, applied in order to the text of both sides after normalize (write them for the normalized text). Example: [{find:"#(\d)",replace:"UNIT $1"}]. Keep each rule narrow

sourceCol.description: Column to take from the lookup sheet. An empty value there leaves the cell as it is; several matching rows with one value (empty ones aside) count as one match

targetFilter.description: Narrow the other side, e.g. WORKTYPE in CM,EM for repair rows

attr.description: Attribute or column name. Join child attributes with a dot, e.g. EXT_WOPERMIT.EXT_PERMITDATE

targetMatchCol.description: Match column(s) on the lookup sheet (same order and count as matchCol)

classify.description: Decide a code from the words in the text. A row gets a code only when the words found give exactly one code; several codes are returned as lookup_ambiguous, no words as unmatched. A word inside a longer word that was found is not counted

field.description: Which entries to use, by their FIELD (for example PROBLEM, CAUSE or REMEDY)

scopeCol.description: Column whose value an entry's SCOPE must equal (for example the failure class, or the problem code for causes). Entries without SCOPE apply to every row

textCol.description: Text column(s) to read the words from (several are joined with a space)

replace.description: Replace the value with the correct value from the dictionary (whole values for MODE text, parts for MODE regex). Rows that match no entry are not changed

fromCol.description: Column to read (default: the column being set)

phase.description: Choose the value by the row's dates (for statuses). Rows without dates are not changed

asOf.description: Date to compare with (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today

finish.description: End date column (e.g. ACTFINISH, TARGCOMPDATE). On or before asOf: past

future.description: Value for rows not started yet (e.g. WAPPR)

inProgress.description: Value for rows in progress (e.g. INPRG)

newRowsOnly.description: Default true: only rows added in the work screen. Existing records keep their status

past.description: Value for past rows. Omit to use the connection's setting for past work (COMP unless the user chose CLOSE)

planned.description: Planned date column (e.g. TARGSTARTDATE, SCHEDSTART). A row with only a planned date is future

start.description: Actual start date column (e.g. ACTSTART). On or before asOf (and not past): inProgress

name: apply_rule
title: Apply a rule
